approach: Static recompilation of the main executable with PS2Recomp, plus a native layer that draws with the PC GPU and handles sound, FMVs and input instead of emulating the VU1, GS and IOP. A readable C++ decomp of the executable replaces, by hook, the parts that matter for modding.
notes: The recompiled C++ is game code and is generated locally from your own disc, so it is not in the repo. Playable on Windows (releases ship with a mod kit), with a Linux x86-64 port in the tree. Mods (PNG textures, skins, custom monsters, custom stages) go in the mods folder, and there is a level editor. Decomp functions are byte-matched where cheap, the rest are kept as functionally equivalent C++ and marked NON_MATCHING. SDK and PS2 hardware code is skipped, since the port replaces it.
help: Hooking decomp functions into the recompiled runtime
